I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. My local cron tool runs in my own environment and can't post into Slack, so nothing would post automatically.

I posted a reply in the #coastal-team thread and then a correction, since my first reply claimed I had no scheduler before I had checked.

What I can do: if you ask me on a Monday, I'll post the "Coastal week ahead" digest in #coastal-team, covering the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus open customer items. Automating it needs someone who can set up a scheduled post on the Slack side.
